SELECT @@server_uuid AS serverUuid, DATABASE() AS schemaName
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{operatorId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = 'ad_account_asset' AND ((column_name = 'account_name' AND column_default = '') OR (column_name = 'inventory_status' AND column_default = 'AVAILABLE') OR (column_name = 'is_manually_updated' AND column_default = '0')) ) = 3 AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND engine = 'InnoDB' AND table_name IN ('ad_account_asset', 'media_channel', 'mig_asset_job', 'mig_asset_item', 'mig_asset_mutex') ) = 5
mapper.sql: (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('sourceId', item.source_id, 'targetId', item.target_id)) OVER (ORDER BY item.ordinal ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM JSON_TABLE(payload_json, '$.items[*]' COLUMNS ( ordinal FOR ORDINALITY, table_name VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.table', source_id BIGINT PATH '$.source_id', target_id BIGINT PATH '$.target_id' )) AS item WHERE item.table_name = 'media_channel' LIMIT 1)
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name =
'mig_channel_prod_test_batch' 'mig_channel_prod_prod_batch' 'mig_asset_invalid_environment'

SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(source_json, '$.fingerprint')) AS sourceFingerprint, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json, '$.target_fingerprint')) AS targetFingerprint, SHA2(payload_json, 256) AS payloadHash, SHA2(CAST( AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4), 256) AS mappingHash FROM WHERE batch_key = #{batchKey} AND state = 'applied' FOR SHARE
SELECT CAST( AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) FROM WHERE batch_key = #{batchKey} AND state = 'applied'
SELECT COUNT(*) = 2 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name IN ('mig_channel_increment_batch', 'mig_channel_increment_mapping') AND engine = 'InnoDB'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = 'media_channel' AND column_name = 'channel_code' AND is_nullable = 'YES') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name IN ('media_channel', 'media_channel_rate') AND engine = 'InnoDB') = 2

SELECT mapping.source_channel_id AS sourceId, mapping.target_channel_id AS targetId FROM mig_channel_increment_mapping mapping INNER JOIN mig_channel_increment_batch batch ON batch.batch_key = mapping.batch_key AND batch.state = 'applied' AND batch.environment = mapping.environment AND batch.source_uuid = mapping.source_uuid AND batch.source_schema = mapping.source_schema AND batch.target_uuid = mapping.target_uuid AND batch.target_schema = mapping.target_schema WHERE mapping.environment = #{environment} AND mapping.source_uuid = #{sourceUuid} AND mapping.source_schema = #{sourceSchema} AND mapping.target_uuid = #{targetUuid} AND mapping.target_schema = #{targetSchema} AND mapping.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY mapping.source_channel_id FOR SHARE

SELECT id, channel_name AS channelName, channel_code AS channelCode FROM media_channel WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND (channel_name = #{channelName} OR (#{channelCode} IS NOT NULL AND #{channelCode} != '' AND channel_code = #{channelCode})) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_channel ( channel_name, channel_short_name, channel_code, channel_type, belong_team, status, putaway_status, settlement_method, settlement_currency, buyout_amount, recharge_amount, payment_address, login_url, remark, tg_group_id, tg_group_name, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{candidate.source.channelName}, #{candidate.source.channelShortName}, NULLIF(TRIM(#{candidate.source.channelCode}), ''), #{candidate.source.channelType}, #{candidate.source.belongTeam}, #{candidate.source.status}, 0, #{candidate.source.settlementMethod}, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{candidate.source.settlementCurrency}), ''), 'USD'), COALESCE(#{candidate.source.buyoutAmount}, 0), 0, #{candidate.source.paymentAddress}, #{candidate.source.loginUrl}, #{candidate.source.remark}, #{candidate.source.tgGroupId}, #{candidate.source.tgGroupName}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId}, #{candidate.source.createdAt}, #{candidate.source.updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO media_channel_rate ( channel_id, service_fee, rebate_rate, effective_date, expiry_date, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{targetChannelId}, #{rate.serviceFee}, #{rate.rebateRate}, #{rate.effectiveDate}, #{rate.expiryDate}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId}, #{rate.createdAt}, COALESCE(#{rate.updatedAt}, #{rate.createdAt}) )

INSERT INTO mig_channel_increment_mapping ( environment, source_uuid, source_schema, target_uuid, target_schema, source_channel_id, target_channel_id, batch_key, operator_id ) VALUES ( #{environment}, #{sourceUuid}, #{sourceSchema}, #{targetUuid}, #{targetSchema}, #{sourceChannelId}, #{targetChannelId}, #{batchKey}, #{operatorId} )

INSERT INTO mig_channel_increment_batch ( batch_key, environment, state, plan_hash, source_uuid, source_schema, target_uuid, target_schema, plan_json, operator_id ) VALUES ( #{batchKey}, #{environment}, 'applied', #{planHash}, #{sourceUuid}, #{sourceSchema}, #{targetUuid}, #{targetSchema}, #{planJson}, #{operatorId} )

INSERT INTO mig_asset_item (job_id, account_id, target_id, action, state, reason, source_json, before_json, desired_json) VALUES
(#{item.jobId}, #{item.accountId}, #{item.targetId}, #{item.action}, #{item.state}, #{item.reason}, #{item.sourceJson}, #{item.beforeJson}, #{item.desiredJson})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, channel_id, channel_name, account_type, account_attribute, is_manually_updated AS manual, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f') AS updatedAt FROM ad_account_asset WHERE account_id IN #{accountId} AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY account_id, id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_account_asset a JOIN mig_asset_item i ON i.target_id = a.id SET a.channel_id = CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.channelId')) AS UNSIGNED), a.channel_name = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.channelName')), a.account_type = CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.accountType')) = 'NULL' THEN NULL ELSE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.accountType')) END, a.account_attribute = CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.accountAttribute')) = 'NULL' THEN NULL ELSE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.accountAttribute')) END WHERE a.deleted_at = 0 AND i.state = 'PENDING' AND i.action = 'UPDATE' AND i.id IN #{item.id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_account_asset (account_id, channel_id, channel_name, account_type, account_attribute, update_source, created_by, updated_by) SELECT i.account_id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.channelId')) AS UNSIGNED), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.channelName')), CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.accountType')) = 'NULL' THEN NULL ELSE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.accountType')) END, CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.accountAttribute')) = 'NULL' THEN NULL ELSE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(i.desired_json, '$.accountAttribute')) END, 'LEGACY_MIGRATION', #{operatorId}, #{operatorId} FROM mig_asset_item i WHERE i.state = 'PENDING' AND i.action = 'INSERT' AND i.id IN #{item.id}
